groups.interpretation: Compute bounded limit as detector end or min(request,end); reject gate<start first then gate>=limit, including equal limit. Invalid gate returns None before cache lookup/write. No local direction validation.
Key native tuple direction,gate,limit,gate_event_time (None allowed); membership hit returns shallow copy of nonnull cached candidate or None. No refresh, revalidation or access-based reorder.
Cache helper checks size>=constant 32768, removes first insertion-order key before copying or storing. FIFO not LRU; if later copy/store raises, eviction already occurred. No local rollback.
Store shallow copy of nonnull result or None under captured key then return original result. Hit/miss alias distinction; no deep immutability or source-generation key.
Convert reaction Break to int, then if earlier than gate OR exact gate time is None, return Break<=gate; earlier Break skips exact time lookup. Equality admits main-only fallback.

Remaining later Break rejects; equal main with exact gate reads Break row and chooses truthy intrabar_start else main open, end main open+TF exclusive. No local clamp of intrabar_start. Exact bearish threshold bottom otherwise top.

Traverse source-order lower generator; exact bearish strict Low<level else High>level. First strict crossing immediately decides timestamp<=gate including equality; no hit compares Break main open<=gate (fallback, not lower evidence).
Read requested direction ledger then RE87 break list, bisect_left at gate; owner defaults cut-1. Assumes aligned ascending list, not validated; no sorting/dedup.

Only if cut<ledger len and first equal Break, evaluate RE90, then replace owner position with cut if true. At most one equal Break evaluated; never scan duplicate equal owners or verify earlier owner exact time.
Default search gate+1; negative owner calls RE91 directly, tag nonnull result no-history, cache and return. No outer/gate crossing search or anchor reconstruction on this branch.
Read owner by position, boundary_end=max(int(owner.First),gate-1), read gate main. No independent physical identity or bounds verification.
Exact bearish computes inclusive outer maximum High First..boundary_end then gate Low; otherwise inclusive outer min Low then gate High. Discard extrema source object; no price conversion here.

Event start truthy exact gate or gate main open; end limit main open+timeframe exclusive. Both bisect_left shared ordered lower times; no local clamping of exact gate. Empty/reversed positional window caches None.

Run both strict indexed crossing queries in order outer then gate. Exact bearish first_greater outer then first_less gate; otherwise first_less outer then first_greater gate. No timestamp-based arbitration or skip second query after hit.
Both positions None caches None. Position zero is evidence, not absence.

Restart iff outer nonnull and (gate null OR outer<=gate). Equal physical position gives restart priority; duplicate timestamp alone not tie. Select position, conditional assertion nonnull, read second_times even for continue, tag restart/continue.

Only restart maps decision timestamp through RE06; absent mapping caches None; start=int(source.index)+1. Continue retains gate+1 even if gate hit later. Reject start>limit, equality allowed; no reuse of reset main as First.
Call RE91 with selected start/limit; if result nonnull assign decision_kind. No canonical ledger acceptance here.

Only continue and missing anchor index OR anchor value enters reconstruction. Filter all direction resets with item.index<int(result.First), then numeric max index (not last list position); no prior resets leaves partial anchor unchanged.

Exact bullish min Low else max High from chosen reset through First-1 inclusive. Replace all anchor index/value/leg boundary even if one component already exists; complete anchor untouched (even if leg boundary None). Cache copy/None and return original.
Exact bullish RED First/GREEN context else GREEN/RED; bound limit, fresh active list, reset_index=max(detector start,requested start-1). No full range/direction validator.
Main scan positional start..limit inclusive; read row, ordered guard scan>reset then First tag then previous context tag. Predecessor not read if earlier guard false.
Build RE92 using fixed reset context and current scan; append nonnull candidate before scanning active list. No immediate same-First confirmation.
Fresh confirmed/survivor lists each main, traverse active insertion order. Scan<=candidate.First survives untouched, skipping invalidation and confirmation.
RE94 owner boundary arbitration before any geometry writes; true drops candidate (not survivor). Conditional source behavior, not arbitrary event chronology guarantee.

Exact bullish strictly lower Low updates bottom and stored Candle.index/display; then strict High>top sets Break stored index/display, refine (ignore analysis result), append confirmed and continue, excludes from survivors.

Otherwise strictly higher High updates top/stored source, strict Low<bottom confirms, stored Break identity, refine, append and continue. Direction branch exact bullish else, separate from RE94/RE78 exact semantics.

Keep remaining unconfirmed survivors, assign active=survivors. After processing all active at first main with confirmations return min First index; equal First keeps first encountered. No cross-candidate sorting by exact lower confirmation; exhaustion None, no accepted ledger append.

supplemental.historical: Gate valid only start<=gate<limit; invalid gate not cached. Key includes exact gate time (possibly null). Hit clones candidate. Store helper evicts oldest insertion at >=32768 before storing shallow copy/null and returning original; not LRU. Cache source-lifetime dependencies deferred.

Same-main owner helper uses native Break index first. Break<gate or null gate time => Break<=gate; later Break false. With equal main, truthy intrabar_start or Break open, no clamp as in RE61; first strict lower crossing determines <=exact gate. No hit compares Break open to gate (fallback, not crossing proof). Exact bearish else nonbearish direction selection.

Lower_bound chooses first equal Break position; previous position cut-1. At most one equal Break candidate checked, no scan of duplicate Breaks. Assumed ordered duplicate-free stream not validated here. No owner searches gate+1, tags no-history if found, caches result.

Outer range inclusive owner First..max(First,gate-1), gate level from gate candle. Lower event window uses truthy gate time or main open through limit open+timeframe exclusive; no local exact-gate clamp, empty caches null.

Both strict lower searches always occur in directional order (outer then gate). Neither => null. Outward nonnull and gate absent or outward<=gate => restart, equal-position priority; otherwise continue. Compare positions not timestamp ties; assertion only guards derived position.

Restart maps exact decision timestamp with DetectorBase selected main and end constraints; source.index+1 becomes new First start. Continue retains gate+1 even when gate crossing occurred in later main. Start>limit rejects, equality permitted.

Tag result route. Continue with missing anchor index OR value searches all resets strictly before result First, picks max index, computes min/max Reset..First-1. Overwrites all anchor index/value/leg boundary fields, including an individually existing anchor component; complete anchor untouched. No prior Reset means no reconstruction.

Set context reset=max(detector start,start-1), scan requested start through bounded end. New eligible adjacent First appended before active scan; candidate with scan<=First retained without evaluation.

Discard invalidated owners before strict geometry update. Collect all confirmations on current main in active order and retain other survivors. Return min First among confirmations immediately after main's candidate loop; equal First preserves first encountered. No cross-candidate exact lower-time ordering.
